how_adapted: No code reused. Browser search via GitHub UI found no usable zero-dependency node:http kanban/REST implementation: code search required sign-in (not available), and repository hits were framework apps (React/MongoDB, Prisma/Express). sosyfy/trello-backend (https://github.com/sosyfy/trello-backend) was opened and inspected visually, but it is Prisma-based and does not match the node:http, no-dependency constraint, so nothing was copied. All code in src/ was written from scratch. Notes: searched and found nothing usable -> written from scratch.
